tasks.label: Build GanyanZekası Debug APK
tasks.command: $env:JAVA_HOME = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Android\Android Studio\jbr'; if (-not (Test-Path $env:JAVA_HOME)) { throw 'Android Studio JBR not found.' }; $env:PATH = (Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin') + ';' + $env:PATH; if (-not $env:ANDROID_HOME) { $env:ANDROID_HOME = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk' }; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME; npm.cmd run android:sync; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; exit $LASTEXITCODE
